mergedParams.userDescription: Heatwave mirage and atmospheric haze. internal effects for text, video, images

output.title: Heatwave Mirage & Atmospheric Haze Internal Effects

prompts.prompt: Create an internal effect preset called 'HeatwaveDistortion' that simulates atmospheric heat distortion through multi-layered transform animations. The effect should use generic AnimationRange to create a wavy, undulating motion that mimics heat rising from hot surfaces. Apply translateY with sine-wave-like keyframes (at least 8 keyframes) that create smooth vertical oscillation, combined with subtle scaleX distortion that creates horizontal waviness. Add a slight blur effect that pulses in and out to simulate focus shifting through heated air. The effect should accept parameters for: intensity (0-1, controls amplitude), speed (duration in ms), blurAmount (0-10px), and waveFrequency (number of oscillations). Use spring easing for organic motion. The effect targets any component type through targetIds and returns a combined effect array with synchronized transform and filter animations.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: Generic (AnimationRange[]). Structure: { effects: [{ type: 'generic', start: 0, duration: params.speed || 2000, mode: 'provider', targetIds: params.targetIds, ranges: [{ key: 'translateY', val: AnimationRange with 8+ keyframes creating sine wave from -intensity*20px to +intensity*20px }, { key: 'scaleX', val: AnimationRange oscillating between 0.98 and 1.02 }, { key: 'filter', val: AnimationRange for blur(0px) to blur(blurAmount) }] }] }. Input schema: z.object({ targetIds: z.array(z.string()), intensity: z.number().min(0).max(1).default(0.5), speed: z.number().default(2000), blurAmount: z.number().default(3), waveFrequency: z.number().default(3) }). PresetMetadata: { _internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects' }. Use requestAnimationFrame-friendly transforms.

prompts.prompt: Build an internal effect preset named 'MirageShimmer' that creates a shimmering, color-shifting effect reminiscent of desert mirages. Use generic effects to animate CSS filter properties including hue-rotate, brightness, and contrast in overlapping cycles. The hue rotation should cycle through 360 degrees with ease-in-out easing, while brightness oscillates between 0.9 and 1.1, and contrast shifts between 0.95 and 1.05. Layer in a subtle opacity fade that creates a ghosting effect. Accept parameters for: shimmerSpeed (ms), colorShiftRange (degrees), brightnessVariance (percentage), and fadeIntensity (0-1). Each property should have different cycle durations to create complex, non-repeating patterns. Target specific component IDs and return multiple effect objects that can be applied simultaneously.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: Generic with multiple concurrent animations. Structure: { effects: [{ type: 'generic', start: 0, duration: params.shimmerSpeed, mode: 'provider', targetIds: params.targetIds, ranges: [{ key: 'filter', val: AnimationRange for hue-rotate(0deg) to hue-rotate(colorShiftRange) with 6 keyframes }, { key: 'brightness', val: AnimationRange oscillating 0.9-1.1 }, { key: 'contrast', val: AnimationRange 0.95-1.05 }, { key: 'opacity', val: AnimationRange with subtle fade 0.95-1.0 }] }] }. Zod schema: z.object({ targetIds: z.array(z.string()), shimmerSpeed: z.number().default(3000), colorShiftRange: z.number().default(180), brightnessVariance: z.number().default(0.1), fadeIntensity: z.number().default(0.05) }). Return format follows _internalPresetOutput: 'effects' pattern.

prompts.prompt: Design an audio-reactive internal effect preset 'AtmosphericPulse' that creates heat haze-like distortions synchronized to audio bass frequencies. Use waveform effects to make elements expand and contract like they're breathing with the music's rhythm. Configure a zoom effect that reacts to bass frequencies with high sensitivity, creating a pulsing scale animation. Layer a subtle shake effect triggered by mid frequencies to add atmospheric turbulence. Include an exposure effect that brightens on beats to simulate heat flashes. Parameters should include: bassIntensity (zoom amount), shakeThreshold (trigger level), exposureBoost (brightness increase), and smoothing (reaction smoothness). The effect should feel like looking through heat-distorted air that pulses with sound.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: Waveform (audio-reactive). Structure: { effects: [{ type: 'waveform', mode: 'provider', targetIds: params.targetIds, props: { zoom: { enabled: true, intensity: params.bassIntensity || 0.15, frequency: 'bass', sensitivity: 0.8, smooth: params.smoothing || 0.3 }, shake: { enabled: true, intensity: 0.05, frequency: 'mid', threshold: params.shakeThreshold || 0.6 }, exposure: { enabled: true, intensity: params.exposureBoost || 0.3, frequency: 'bass', sensitivity: 0.7 } } }] }. Input schema: z.object({ targetIds: z.array(z.string()), bassIntensity: z.number().default(0.15), shakeThreshold: z.number().default(0.6), exposureBoost: z.number().default(0.3), smoothing: z.number().default(0.3) }). PresetMetadata includes dependencies if using audio data.

prompts.prompt: Develop a combined internal effect preset 'HazeLayer' that stacks multiple atmospheric effects to create depth and dimension. Start with a base generic effect that adds a subtle gaussian blur animation cycling from 0 to 4px. Layer a transform effect that creates slow horizontal drift using translateX with ease-in-out easing. Add a third effect for opacity that creates a misty fade, oscillating between 0.7 and 1.0. Include parameters for: driftDistance (pixels), driftSpeed (ms), blurRange (max blur), opacityMin (lowest opacity), and stagger (delay between effect starts). Each effect should have slightly different timing to create natural, asynchronous movement. Return an array of effect objects that can be applied to create a comprehensive haze effect.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: Combined (multiple generic effects). Structure: { effects: [{ type: 'generic', start: 0, duration: params.driftSpeed, mode: 'provider', targetIds: params.targetIds, ranges: [{ key: 'filter', val: AnimationRange blur(0px) to blur(blurRange) }] }, { type: 'generic', start: params.stagger, duration: params.driftSpeed * 1.2, mode: 'provider', targetIds: params.targetIds, ranges: [{ key: 'translateX', val: AnimationRange -driftDistance to +driftDistance }] }, { type: 'generic', start: params.stagger * 2, duration: params.driftSpeed * 0.8, mode: 'provider', targetIds: params.targetIds, ranges: [{ key: 'opacity', val: AnimationRange opacityMin to 1.0 }] }] }. Schema: z.object({ targetIds: z.array(z.string()), driftDistance: z.number().default(30), driftSpeed: z.number().default(4000), blurRange: z.number().default(4), opacityMin: z.number().default(0.7), stagger: z.number().default(200) }).

prompts.prompt: Create an internal effect preset 'ChromaticAberration' that simulates the color separation effect seen through heated air or distorted glass. Use generic effects to animate text-shadow or box-shadow properties with RGB color offsets. Create three shadow layers - red shifted left, green centered, blue shifted right - that move independently. Animate the offset distances to create a breathing chromatic effect. Add a subtle scale animation that makes the element appear to float. Parameters: aberrationStrength (pixel offset), pulseSpeed (animation duration), colorIntensity (opacity of shadows), and floatAmount (scale variance). The effect should work on both text and container elements, creating a dreamy, heat-distorted appearance.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: Generic with complex shadow animations. Structure: { effects: [{ type: 'generic', start: 0, duration: params.pulseSpeed, mode: 'provider', targetIds: params.targetIds, ranges: [{ key: 'textShadow', val: AnimationRange with keyframes for RGB shadow separation: prog 0: '0 0 0 transparent', prog 0.5: `${-aberrationStrength}px 0 0 rgba(255,0,0,${colorIntensity}), ${aberrationStrength}px 0 0 rgba(0,0,255,${colorIntensity})`, prog 1: '0 0 0 transparent' }, { key: 'scale', val: AnimationRange from 1.0 to 1.0 + floatAmount }] }] }. Input: z.object({ targetIds: z.array(z.string()), aberrationStrength: z.number().default(3), pulseSpeed: z.number().default(2500), colorIntensity: z.number().default(0.4), floatAmount: z.number().default(0.02) }). Use GPU-accelerated properties.

prompts.prompt: Build an internal effect preset 'ThermalWave' that creates rolling heat waves across elements. Design a complex transform effect using multiple translateY and skewX animations with staggered timings to simulate thermal currents. Create a wave that starts at the bottom and rolls upward, with skew creating a warping effect. Add brightness fluctuation that follows the wave pattern. Include parameters for: waveHeight (vertical displacement), waveSpeed (propagation speed), skewAngle (distortion amount), brightnessBoost (thermal glow), and waveCount (number of waves). Use spring easing for natural thermal movement. The effect should make elements appear to be viewed through rising hot air currents.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: Generic with wave propagation. Structure: { effects: Array.from({ length: params.waveCount }, (_, i) => ({ type: 'generic', start: i * (params.waveSpeed / params.waveCount), duration: params.waveSpeed, mode: 'provider', targetIds: params.targetIds, ranges: [{ key: 'translateY', val: AnimationRange with sine wave pattern from 0 to -waveHeight }, { key: 'transform', val: AnimationRange for skewX(0deg) to skewX(skewAngle) to skewX(0deg) }, { key: 'filter', val: AnimationRange brightness(1) to brightness(1 + brightnessBoost) }], easing: 'spring' })) }. Schema: z.object({ targetIds: z.array(z.string()), waveHeight: z.number().default(20), waveSpeed: z.number().default(1500), skewAngle: z.number().default(2), brightnessBoost: z.number().default(0.2), waveCount: z.number().default(3) }).

prompts.prompt: Design an audio-reactive internal effect preset 'FrequencyHaze' that creates atmospheric distortion based on frequency spectrum analysis. Use waveform effects to map different frequency bands to different distortion types: bass frequencies control blur intensity, mid frequencies drive rotation, and treble frequencies affect opacity. Configure the effect to create a swirling, hazy atmosphere that responds to music dynamics. Parameters should include: blurResponse (bass sensitivity), rotationRange (degrees), opacityVariance (fade amount), and frequencySmoothing (reaction smoothness). The effect should create an ethereal, frequency-driven haze that makes elements appear to float in audio-reactive atmosphere.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: Waveform with multi-frequency mapping. Structure: { effects: [{ type: 'waveform', mode: 'provider', targetIds: params.targetIds, props: { blur: { enabled: true, intensity: params.blurResponse || 5, frequency: 'bass', sensitivity: 0.7, smooth: params.frequencySmoothing }, rotate: { enabled: true, intensity: params.rotationRange || 15, frequency: 'mid', sensitivity: 0.6, smooth: params.frequencySmoothing * 1.2 }, scale: { enabled: true, intensity: 0.05, frequency: 'treble', sensitivity: 0.5 } } }] }. Input: z.object({ targetIds: z.array(z.string()), blurResponse: z.number().default(5), rotationRange: z.number().default(15), opacityVariance: z.number().default(0.2), frequencySmoothing: z.number().default(0.4) }). Requires audio data dependencies.

prompts.prompt: Create an internal effect preset 'MirageDisplacement' that uses CSS custom properties and calc() functions to create dynamic displacement mapping effects. Animate custom CSS variables that control transform-origin, perspective, and rotateX/rotateY to create a 3D heat distortion. The effect should make elements appear to bend and warp as if viewed through heated glass. Include keyframes that shift the transform-origin to create rolling distortion. Parameters: perspectiveDistance (3D depth), tiltAngle (X/Y rotation range), originShift (transform-origin movement), duration (effect speed), and intensity (overall strength multiplier). Use ease-in-out easing for smooth transitions.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: Generic with 3D transforms. Structure: { effects: [{ type: 'generic', start: 0, duration: params.duration, mode: 'provider', targetIds: params.targetIds, ranges: [{ key: 'transform', val: AnimationRange with perspective(perspectiveDistance) rotateX/Y animations }, { key: 'transformOrigin', val: AnimationRange shifting from '0% 50%' to '100% 50%' to '50% 50%' }, { key: 'opacity', val: AnimationRange with subtle fade 0.9 to 1.0 }], style: { '--perspective': `${perspectiveDistance}px`, '--tilt-x': `${tiltAngle}deg`, '--tilt-y': `${tiltAngle * 0.7}deg` } }] }. Schema: z.object({ targetIds: z.array(z.string()), perspectiveDistance: z.number().default(1000), tiltAngle: z.number().default(5), originShift: z.number().default(50), duration: z.number().default(3000), intensity: z.number().default(1) }).

prompts.prompt: Develop an internal effect preset 'AtmosphericGradient' that creates dynamic gradient overlays simulating heat haze color shifts. Use generic effects to animate background gradient properties, creating shifting color bands that move vertically like heat waves. Animate linear-gradient angles and color stops to create flowing atmospheric effects. Include subtle backdrop-filter animations for additional depth. Parameters: gradientColors (array of colors), flowSpeed (animation duration), gradientAngle (rotation), blendMode (mix-blend-mode value), and opacity (overlay strength). The effect should create a translucent, flowing color layer that enhances the heat distortion illusion.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: Generic with gradient animation. Structure: { effects: [{ type: 'generic', start: 0, duration: params.flowSpeed, mode: 'provider', targetIds: params.targetIds, ranges: [{ key: 'background', val: AnimationRange for linear-gradient animations with color stop positions }, { key: 'opacity', val: AnimationRange from opacity * 0.7 to opacity }, { key: 'backdropFilter', val: AnimationRange blur(0px) to blur(2px) }, { key: 'mixBlendMode', val: params.blendMode }] }] }. Input: z.object({ targetIds: z.array(z.string()), gradientColors: z.array(z.string()).default(['rgba(255,100,0,0.1)', 'rgba(255,200,0,0.05)']), flowSpeed: z.number().default(5000), gradientAngle: z.number().default(180), blendMode: z.string().default('screen'), opacity: z.number().default(0.3) }). CSS gradient syntax optimization.

prompts.prompt: Build a combined internal effect preset 'QuantumHaze' that layers both generic and waveform effects to create a complex atmospheric distortion. Start with a base generic effect that creates a slow, hypnotic rotation using rotate3d for pseudo-3D movement. Add a waveform effect layer that responds to audio with scale and blur modulation. Include a third generic effect that creates particle-like shimmer using multiple box-shadows that move independently. Parameters: rotationAxis (3D vector), audioSensitivity (waveform response), particleCount (shadow instances), glowIntensity (shadow blur/spread), and phaseOffset (timing variations). The combined effect should create a surreal, multi-dimensional haze.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: Combined (generic + waveform). Structure: { effects: [{ type: 'generic', start: 0, duration: 4000, mode: 'provider', targetIds: params.targetIds, ranges: [{ key: 'transform', val: AnimationRange for rotate3d(x,y,z,angle) }] }, { type: 'waveform', mode: 'provider', targetIds: params.targetIds, props: { scale: { enabled: true, intensity: params.audioSensitivity * 0.1, frequency: 'bass' }, blur: { enabled: true, intensity: params.audioSensitivity * 3, frequency: 'mid' } } }, { type: 'generic', start: params.phaseOffset, duration: 3000, mode: 'provider', targetIds: params.targetIds, ranges: [{ key: 'boxShadow', val: AnimationRange with multiple shadow layers }] }] }. Schema: z.object({ targetIds: z.array(z.string()), rotationAxis: z.array(z.number()).length(3).default([1,1,0]), audioSensitivity: z.number().default(0.7), particleCount: z.number().default(5), glowIntensity: z.number().default(10), phaseOffset: z.number().default(500) }).
